text:
It is not possible to determine whether any fire occurred on the asset during the whole evaluated period, September 25–October 25, 2026.

NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting the asset during the covered portion, September 25–October 24. However, all four sensors lacked coverage for October 24–25. Even during covered days, small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may have gone undetected.
